newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ median house price flat in May - REINZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ median house price flat in May - REINZ.

text.p: New Zealand's national median house price remained flat at NZ$162,500 in May, while the Auckland median price dropped by $1,000 to $235,000, the Real Estate Institute (REINZ) said on Wednesday.
The REINZ said the number of homes sold in May was similar to the total in April.
Real estate agents reported a total of 7,976 homes sold in May, compared to 8,080 in April and 8,025 homes sold in May 1996.
Sales in metropolitan Auckland totalled 2,356, down 42 on last month's figures.
REINZ national vice-president Max Oliver said the latest figures confirmed the lack of market confidence noted last month, which was particularly noticeable in the main centres.

"City dwellers seem to have been slightly more cautious during May, resulting in a slight reduction in the total number of homes sold in a market which could best be described as 'static' overall," Oliver said.
"The latest figures continue to reinforce the Institute's view that the residential property market is a consistent barometer of the New Zealand economy."
Home sales in Wellington dipped to 982 from 1,025 in April, while sales in the Canterbury/Westland region fell to 1,168 from 1,246 in April.
